environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in an isolated VPC (vpc-0x9f8e7d6c) with no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached. Route tables contain only local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) entries. Access to S3 is provided exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy scoped to arn:aws:s3:::approved-bucket-prod/* only. The config service is accessible via a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f interface endpoint with private DNS enabled. Security group sg-0xabc123 on the Lambda ENI allows egress only to prefix list pl-63a5400a (S3) on port 443 and to the config service endpoint ENI (10.0.3.0/28) on port 8080. No other egress rules exist. DNS resolution within the VPC resolves only to VPC-internal addresses via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint.

config.dns: Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint, no external DNS forwarding
